title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 3: the defeat of Og king of Bashan, the land east of the Jordan and Moses at Pisgah.

questions.text: Where did Og the king of Bashan come out to fight Israel?
questions.explanation: Og the king of Bashan came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

questions.text: How many cities did Israel take in the region of Argob?
questions.explanation: They took all his cities: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

questions.text: What do the Sidonians call Mount Hermon?
questions.explanation: The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.

questions.text: What was the bedstead of Og king of Bashan made of?
questions.explanation: Og remained of the remnant of the Rephaim, and his bedstead was a bedstead of iron.

questions.text: What did Jair the son of Manasseh call the region of Argob, after his own name?
questions.explanation: Jair took all the region of Argob and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair.

questions.text: To whom did Moses give Gilead, according to verse 15?
questions.explanation: Moses says simply, "I gave Gilead to Machir."

questions.text: What did Moses say would stay in the cities while the men of valor went over armed before their brothers?
questions.explanation: Their wives, little ones and livestock were to live in the cities Moses had given them.

answers.text: Their wives, little ones and livestock
The old men and the Levites

questions.text: What did Moses beg Yahweh to let him do?
questions.explanation: Moses asked, "Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon."

answers.text: Lead the army against Og again
Go over and see the good land

questions.text: Where did Yahweh tell Moses to go up to see the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to go up to the top of Pisgah and look in every direction, for he would not go over the Jordan.

questions.text: Where did Israel stay at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: So they stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

answers.text: In the valley near Beth Peor
